title: anim.lead_in/1
description: data/anim/lead_in.json: the blows whose body leads the contact (docs/animation/lead-in.md; AnimFighter._lead_in). For each key set listed under `pieces`, over the last ticks before the contact the hips, spine, legs and free arm ease toward the contact key by `weights` (index 0 is the tick before the contact), while the striking limb keeps its chamber and lands on the contact tick. `arm` is the free arm's own list. A row may carry its own lists; an empty row takes the file's. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-reference to add in tools/lib/xref-fight.js (anim-lead-in-keyset: every key under pieces is a key set of a wave's keysets file).

weights.description: How far toward the contact key, 0 to 1, on each tick before the contact: the tick before it first.
